title: Reachable
summary: Shadowfetch Linux 2.0.1 «Umbra» — a Debian-testing derivative with KDE Plasma 6. This release repairs apt on installed systems, makes the on-device AI tools reachable from the application menu, and adds virtual-machine guest integration.

limitations.summary: The ISO cannot be copied onto a FAT32-formatted USB stick.
limitations.detail: FAT32 caps a single file at 4 GiB (4,294,967,295 bytes). This ISO is 4,486,000,640 bytes — 191,033,345 bytes (182 MiB) over that limit — so a plain file copy to a FAT32 stick fails with "file too large". Write the ISO to the USB device with an image writer (balenaEtcher, KDE ISO Image Writer, GNOME Disks) or dd instead of copying it onto a mounted FAT32 filesystem.
